services.name: Sea Kayaking Classes
services.desc: Protected waters along the peninsula and sheltered bays provide an inviting environment for paddling. Travelers who enjoy kayaking can glide past eelgrass beds, observe seabirds, and, in some seasons, experience bioluminescence after dark when conditions align. Exploring from the water offers a different perspective

services.name: Surf and wake
services.desc: The western edge of Point Reyes faces the full force of the Pacific. Long sandy beaches and rugged surf zones allow travelers to experience California’s coastline in its rawest form. Wide-angle views of waves, dunes, and cliff lines can be captured on popular beaches and quieter stretches alike. Coastal fog is common,

services.name: Wildlife tour
services.desc: Autumn frequently offers some of the clearest weather, with crisp air and far-reaching views. Winter is cooler and can bring dramatic storms that create impressive surf conditions along the outer coast. This is also the prime season for gray whale migration, drawing visitors to high viewpoints. Trails and beaches

blurb: Guests explore the rugged coastline, estuaries, and forests of Point Reyes National Seashore through guided kayaking and hiking. Activities include paddling on calm bays, wildlife observation, and coastal hiking with panoramic views. Seasonal experiences include bioluminescence night paddling and whale watching.
